nodes.title: Fixed large-file OOM with streaming parser
nodes.content:
## What

Replaced the chunked pandas reader with a streaming csv parser.

## Why

Follows from the OOM result in brisk-otter-0002.

## Method

stdlib csv over a buffered reader; peak RSS measured with /usr/bin/time.

## Result

2.3GB file ingests in 84s at 210MB peak RSS. Fix verified.

## Repo

- repo: none
- branch: main
- commit: 0000000
